diagnostics.decoder_measurement: initial and epoch log-odds, effective probabilities, sigmoid slopes, parameter displacement, epoch gradient RMS
diagnostics.gradient_limit: increment subtraction has floating-point cancellation; cosine is undefined if either norm is zero; associative, not causal
diagnostics.gradient_measurement: prediction gradient before observation; auxiliary accumulation increment after observation and before optimizer step
diagnostics.interventions: sampling and query detach only; no decoder initialization tuning or auxiliary ablation in this stage

protocol.evaluation_partition: validation-only; test events removed before model construction
protocol.inference: already inspected development prefixes; descriptive, no significance, no test or publication claim

paired_design.candidates: identical across models for each training policy/seed/epoch; evaluation identical across cells/seeds/epochs
paired_design.initialization: identical across routing and training policies within seed and model family
paired_design.legacy_boundary: prior legacy results preserved; not a matched decoder comparison with this validation-only study
paired_design.primary_interaction: mixed routing delta minus random routing delta, paired within seed
paired_design.primary_routing_delta: decoupled minus coupled, separately for each training policy

protocol.primary_endpoint: fixed-final-epoch validation AP/AUC by regime and cohort; paired routing-by-sampling interaction

sampling.budget: one negative per supported positive under both training policies; identical base random draws and availability across policies
sampling.empty_random_support: skip scored row and observe event; no synthetic candidate
sampling.evaluation: unchanged typed regimes with explicit skips and no fallback
sampling.history: strictly earlier complete timestamp groups; exclude every current positive of the source
sampling.missing_history: explicit random-only stratum; never relabel as a historical sample

protocol.selection: secondary checkpoint: equal-weight mean of all-cohort validation AP across all registered regimes; earliest epoch on ties; empty support is an error

tgn.event_features: train and validation stream only; observed after query

upstream.mode: fetch-only; original modules loaded from a clean external checkout
upstream.status: development comparator; not admitted benchmark evidence
